rules.title: San Francisco Just Cause Eviction Requirements
rules.requirement: Landlords must have one of 17 permitted just cause reasons to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, and the mere expiration of a lease or change in ownership does not constitute just cause.

coverage.summary: Covers rental units subject to the Rent Ordinance, including units exempt from rent increases such as those built after June 13, 1979.

rules.exemptions: None specified for just cause coverage; even units exempt from rent limits may still be subject to just cause eviction provisions.
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
